priorityList: Cast Whirlwind if the Whirlwind cleave buff is missing to enable multi-target damage.
Cast Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally synchronized with each other.
Cast Rampage if Enrage is about to expire or if you have 110 or more Rage.
Cast Bladestorm while Enraged, specifically when Recklessness is active or has more than 10 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Execute if Sudden Death procs.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active to maximize Rage spending.
Cast Whirlwind while Recklessness is active to maintain cleave stacks.
Cast Crushing Blow (Enraged Raging Blow) on cooldown.
Cast Bloodthirst to generate Rage and maintain Enrage.
Cast Rend if the bleed duration is less than 6 seconds.
Cast Execute on targets below the health threshold.
Cast Rampage as your primary Rage spender.
Cast Whirlwind or Raging Blow as fillers to generate Rage and maintain cleave.
